experiences.fullDescription:
• Built a live sports-commentary broadcast pipeline over Apache Kafka, turning a game engine's event stream into synchronized audio-visual broadcasts, and cut end-to-end latency by 73% by running the audio and video branches in parallel and reusing match state across turns.
• Engineered the sample-level audio/video alignment stage that matches each generated video frame to its exact slice of TTS audio, by sample rate and bit depth, before muxing into the output stream.
• Grounded a Gemma-based commentary model in live match state with structured prompts and emotion labels, cutting output degradation by 80%, so a goal and a throw-in are never called in the same tone.
• Moved speech synthesis from ElevenLabs to a self-hosted Dia model and brought video generation in-house, removing per-call vendor costs and a network round trip from the live path; planned the GPU hardware for both workloads within a fixed budget.
• Designed the monitor/selector stage that picks what the viewer sees at any moment (commentary, leaderboard or crowd reaction), so the pipeline can feed a live director instead of a single screen.
• Secured the distributed inference infrastructure with FastAPI credential management, TOTP multi-factor authentication and rotating JWTs, and ran the team's GPU inference server day to day.

• Built Spring Boot microservices for HP's Workforce Experience Platform (WXP), a Device-as-a-Service product that lets enterprises manage thousands of remote devices across regions.
• Consolidated fragmented REST endpoints into a single GraphQL API on AWS, cutting system complexity by 35%.
• Helped define tiered subscription plans with cross-functional teams, positioning the platform for an estimated 28% rise in adoption.
• Built per-tenant notification widgets for Slack and Microsoft Teams on fastn.ai's webhook API, cutting alert response times by 45%.
• Maintained HP's Go-based string-translation service for 20+ languages, with access control and translation workflows, and kept tenant data isolated on shared infrastructure.

• Redesigned HP TechPulse's reporting to support fleet health monitoring and predictive maintenance for enterprise clients.
• Built a secure telemetry pipeline on AWS Kinesis and Redshift, improving reporting efficiency by 65%.
• Streamed WMI events from Windows clients in real time, cutting end-to-end latency from 60 ms to under 17 ms.
• Built analytics dashboards on the AWS QuickSight API, turning millions of telemetry data points into operational insights.
• Delivered cost optimizations projected to save enterprise clients $250,000 a year.

• Refactored SQL Server stored procedures and multi-table joins using execution plans, making billing cycles 40% faster.
• Built a Python ETL framework that ingests from multiple upstream systems, cutting manual billing corrections by 95%.
• Orchestrated billing pipelines in Apache Airflow with SLA-aligned scheduling, monitoring and alerts.
• Set up CI/CD with Git, Jenkins and Airflow, plus Linux job-monitoring scripts that cut billing-run failures by 78%.
• Ran billing on AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda), handling 3x peak transaction volume while cutting infrastructure costs by 30%.

• Supported RK Vaishnavi Academy's move to remote teaching, administering Google Workspace, the Admin Console and YouTube Studio.
• Coordinated online events and ran the academy's online learning platform day to day.
• Worked with the founding director on planning and the technology setup for the academy's online programs.
• Produced lecture and event videos in Adobe Premiere Pro.

• Built TensorFlow models on COVID-19 data, improving trend-prediction accuracy by 35% through feature engineering.
• Analyzed and visualized case data to identify transmission-risk patterns.
• Built FBProphet forecasting dashboards to spot emerging hotspots and anticipate resource needs.
• Worked with epidemiologists and public health officials to turn findings into actionable insights.

• Designed the software concept for a Depression Coping Service, drawing on training from the Education Research cell at IIT Bombay.
• Turned research on mental-health interventions into a system design: user flows, core components and engagement features.
• Framed the platform around evidence-based support for people managing depression.

• Built Python processing for medical-device data in the HL7 standard, integrating clinical monitoring systems.
• Wrote algorithms to transform physiological sensor readings for real-time patient monitoring.
• Designed a real-time data pipeline that improved patient monitoring accuracy by 28%.
• Added validation routines that catch erroneous sensor readings, and worked with clinicians on data dashboards.

• Developed unsupervised image-segmentation algorithms combining wavelet transforms and clustering, 20% more accurate than established methods.
• Implemented adaptive mask filters in MATLAB that adjust to each image for better edge detection and feature extraction.
• Benchmarked the techniques against standard methods for both precision and processing efficiency.
